title: Heaven’s Gate
subtitle: Your original arcade favourite.
note: Three buttons. One full power bar. Block + Kick + Punch.

title: Cadillacs & Dinosaurs
subtitle: A little prehistoric couch co-op.
note: Bring a second controller. Attack, jump, and keep moving.

title: Tekken 3
subtitle: Step into the King of Iron Fist.
note: Four attack buttons. Pick a fighter and make it your own.

title: Street Fighter II
subtitle: Champion Edition. Settle it in the arcade.
note: Three punches. Three kicks. A classic for two.

title: Final Fight
subtitle: Clean up Metro City.
note: Attack and jump. Keep the crowd on one side.

title: Golden Axe
subtitle: Swords, sorcery, and a friend.
note: Choose your warrior and save your magic for the right moment.

title: The King of Dragons
subtitle: Choose a class. Take on the kingdom.
note: Learn your character’s reach before taking on the next boss.

title: Knights of the Round
subtitle: A quest worthy of the round table.
note: Arthur, Lancelot, or Perceval. Make your choice.

title: Shadow over Mystara
subtitle: An adventure best shared.
note: Check your inventory and keep your party together.

title: Alien vs. Predator
subtitle: Pick your side. Survive the swarm.
note: Melee, jump, shoot. Watch both sides.
